title: 受控源的等效变换
statement: 图示电路中，I_s = 6 A（方向向上），R_1 = 6 Ω，R_2 = 3 Ω；电流控制电压源（CCVS）的电压为 3i_1（“+”在上），i_1 是流过 R_1 的电流（参考方向见图）。
把“CCVS 串联 R_2”变换为受控电流源并联电阻，求结点 a 的电压 v_a、控制电流 i_1，以及 CCVS 吸收的功率。

questions.explain: 3i_1 串 3 Ω → 受控电流源 i_1（注入 a）并 3 Ω。a 点 KCL：6 + i_1 = v_a/6 + v_a/3，i_1 = v_a/6 → 6 = v_a/3，v_a = 18 V。

questions.ask: CCVS 吸收的功率 P = ?（发出为负）
questions.explain: CCVS 电压 3i_1 = 9 V；回到原电路，R_2 中电流 (18 − 9)/3 = 3 A，从“+”端流入，P = 9 × 3 = 27 W（吸收）。

hints: 受控源也可以像独立源那样做等效变换：受控电压源 v 串 R ⇔ 受控电流源 v/R 并 R，方向规则相同。
变换时控制量所在的支路（R_1）不能被变换掉，否则控制量就“消失”了。
变换后只有一个结点 a：列 KCL，再用 i_1 = v_a/R_1 消去控制量。
solution: **1. 变换。** CCVS 3i_1（“+”在上）串 R_2 = 3 Ω → 受控电流源 3i_1/3 = i_1，方向指向 a（向上），并联 3 Ω。R_1 是控制支路，保留不动。
**4. 回到原电路求功率。** CCVS 电压 3i_1 = 9 V，R_2 中电流 (v_a − 9)/3 = 3 A 从 a 流向 c，再从“+”端流入 CCVS：P = 9 × 3 = **27 W**（吸收）。

en.title: Transforming a dependent source
statement: In the circuit, I_s = 6 A (up), R_1 = 6 Ω, R_2 = 3 Ω; the current-controlled voltage source (CCVS) has voltage 3i_1 (+ at the top), where i_1 is the current through R_1 (reference direction as drawn).
Transform "CCVS in series with R_2" into a dependent current source in parallel with a resistor and find the voltage v_a of node a, the controlling current i_1 and the power absorbed by the CCVS.

questions.explain: 3i_1 in series with 3 Ω → a dependent current source i_1 (into a) in parallel with 3 Ω. KCL at a: 6 + i_1 = v_a/6 + v_a/3 with i_1 = v_a/6 → 6 = v_a/3, v_a = 18 V.

questions.ask: Power absorbed by the CCVS, P = ? (negative = delivered)
questions.explain: The CCVS voltage is 3i_1 = 9 V; back in the original circuit R_2 carries (18 − 9)/3 = 3 A into its + terminal, so P = 9 × 3 = 27 W (absorbed).

hints: Dependent sources can be transformed just like independent ones: a dependent voltage source v in series with R ⇔ a dependent current source v/R in parallel with R, with the same direction rule.
The branch carrying the controlling quantity (R_1) must not be transformed away, or the controlling variable "disappears".
After the transformation only node a is left: write KCL, then eliminate the controlling variable with i_1 = v_a/R_1.
solution: **1. Transform.** CCVS 3i_1 (+ at the top) in series with R_2 = 3 Ω → dependent current source 3i_1/3 = i_1 pointing towards a (up), in parallel with 3 Ω. R_1 is the controlling branch and is left untouched.
**3. Controlling variable.** i_1 = v_a/6; substitute: 6 + v_a/6 = v_a/2 → v_a/3 = 6 → **v_a = 18 V**, **i_1 = 3 A**.
**4. Back to the original for the power.** The CCVS voltage is 3i_1 = 9 V; R_2 carries (v_a − 9)/3 = 3 A from a to c, entering the CCVS at +: P = 9 × 3 = **27 W** (absorbed).
